scope: Frozen powdered brain samples were weighed and added to lysis buffer (8 M Urea, 0.4 M ammonium bicarbonate, Complete Protease inhibitor (Roche)) at 1:10 weight:volume.
Samples were homogenised by sonication, and cleared by centrifugation at 14,000 rpm, 4°C, 10 min on a desktop centrifuge.
Lysates were quantified by BCA assay, and adjusted to 100 µg protein in 50 µL 8 M Urea, 0.4 M ammonium bicarbonate.

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The material analyzed by MS was derived from total brain tissue homogenates/lysates. While the results discuss enrichment of nuclear proteins in certain regions, this refers to biological abundance within the whole lysate, not a physical subcellular fractionation step prior to MS analysis.
